items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: The first time I met him, I was with Lloyd Hunter's band. The Inkspots, Bill Kenny

ctx.x: Yes, yeah. Well, he was more addicted and whatnot. He was real committed to it, wasn't he?
Oh, yes. The first time I met him, I was with Lloyd Hunter's band. The Inkspots, Bill Kenny, because Hoppy with with him then, the bass player -- singer.
